items: 【Increased Height and Width Design】Our retractable baby gate features a 42-inch increased height, which can prevent your baby and dog from jumping over or climbing through the baby gate, enhancing safety. The width is adjustable from 0 to 120 inches, meeting your needs for large openings. When not in use, the mesh can be fully retracted, saving your space.

【Specially Designed for Busy Moms】We have 2 locking mechanisms. One is a mesh locking mechanism that automatically locks after a countdown timer, and also controls the extension and retraction of the mesh. The other is a gate locking mechanism - simply unlock the gate right where you are, and the gate will open. And the gate will automatically lock when closed, for quick and easy access. Unlike other baby gates, you don't have to go through a multi-step process of unlocking the mesh, then opening the gate, and finally remembering to lock the mesh again. Our baby gate saves you that hassle.

【Safe and Scratch-Resistant Mesh】Our retractable mesh gate is made with soft material, which is much safer than traditional metal fences, so you don't have to worry about your child getting injured from collisions. The upgraded mesh can withstand scratches from pet claws and is not easily damaged. It is suitable for children under 30 months old or small to medium-sized pets under 45 lbs.

【One-Handed Control】Our retractable dog gate features a simple yet secure one-handed control. It's easy for adults to open and close, even while holding a baby or other items. Babies and pets are unable to open it, ensuring their safety.

【Fiberglass Support】We have upgraded the retractable gate with fiberglass support strips, which prevent kids and pets from going under the mesh and reduce wrinkling. The mesh expands smoothly without getting stuck, making it effortless to use.

【Easy Installation】Installation is easy with adjustable sliding brackets that fit any baseboard without the need for additional shims. Installs quickly in just a few minutes. Note that it should not be installed on drywall and requires drilling, providing a safer option compared to non-drilling baby gates.

【Suitable for Indoor and Outdoor Use】This retractable gate can be used in a variety of indoor and outdoor settings, such as open-concept kitchens, stairways, entryways, bedrooms, living rooms, around fireplaces, on patios, decks, in garages, and other restricted areas. Keeping your children and pets away from hazardous locations.
